items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Adds No Code Contract Management App To Its AgentExchange
items.summary: Agiloft launched a no-code enterprise contract management app for Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) on AgentExchange, integrating contract workflows directly into the CRM environment. The app connects CRM, legal, finance, and sales teams using real-time data sync and automation to centralize contract operations. The launch expands Salesforce's ecosystem with an enterprise-grade contract lifecycle management option aimed at complex organizational workflows. For more ideas in this part of the software...

items.title: Arista Networks vs. Salesforce: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?

items.title: Warsh at Jackson Hole, Nvidia Earnings: What to Watch Next Week
items.summary: It’s late August, but the coming week will be a big one for markets. Headline events include Nvidia earnings after the bell Wednesday and Kevin Warsh’s first major policy speech as Federal Reserve chairman on Friday.

items.title: What Adobe Stock's Low Earnings Multiple Is Actually Priced On
items.summary: Adobe stock trades well below the market on earnings, and the subscription book that has to produce the next set of them is one the company has chosen to grow more slowly.

items.title: Zoom Stock Is Priced Three Separate Ways At Once
